answer.text:
Microsoft’s gross margin percentage was **68.7%** for the three months ended December 31, 2024.

**Calculation:** Gross margin ÷ revenue × 100 = **$47,833 million ÷ $69,632 million × 100 = 68.7%**.

The income statement figures are from Microsoft’s 10-Q, accession **0000950170-25-010491**, **Item 2, “Summary Results of Operations,” chunk c0afa9dd-a3a0-52f0-907e-3491234bc030**.
